cohort: Completed retrospective relevance-screen retained cohort; missing authors excluded.
topic_membership: A post belongs to a broad topic when it carries at least one component label in that dashboard category.
intersection_scope: All Gemma labels observed on the topic posts, excluding the labels defining the topic itself.
overall_formula: (percent topic posts with intersecting label + percent topic authors using intersecting label on a topic post) / 2
author_restriction: The intersecting label must occur on the author’s post within the selected topic; use only on another post does not count.
fractional_attribution: For each intersecting label, a qualifying post is split equally across topic component labels present on that post. A qualifying author is split equally across component labels present on that author’s qualifying topic posts. The two percentage-point contributions are averaged.
reconciliation: For each intersecting label, component link values sum to overall_value.
visualization_guidance: Render component labels as one contiguous chord group and intersecting labels as the opposing group. Link width uses links[].value. Overall tooltips use intersections[].overall_value.
privacy: Only percentages and label names are exported; no post counts, author counts, text, or identifiers.
